notes: Compiled by the Clerk from official sources; Michigan's section begins on page 38 of the PDF. The file on disk was saved by ballot/a build step. Its lines are the controls of President, U.S. Senator and U.S. Representative.

The county clerk's own database of past results, the canvassing county's publication; 204 of its 204 contests and questions of this election carry a date of verification. The source documents it names for this election: "November 3, 2020 General Election Statement of Votes Cast" (195 of 195 contests marked verified); their host did not answer on 2026-10-23, so the figures are the database's. Read through the same service its pages use. Every state contest in it is compared with the Bureau of Elections' official county figures (see the checks). The county's figures only: no precincts are read.

The county clerk's own database of past results, the canvassing county's publication; 155 of its 155 contests and questions of this election carry a date of verification. It names no source document for this election. Read through the same service its pages use. Every state contest in it is compared with the Bureau of Elections' official county figures (see the checks). The county's figures only: no precincts are read.

The Michigan Voter Information Center's own download link, read through a browser on 2026-10-02 because the site refuses scripts (this loader never requests it); the SHA-256 says which bytes were read. The file's own last line reads RECORDS: 6932 RESULTS: OFFICIAL. The official record by county of every contest the state canvasses. Of each row the office, county, candidate's number, names, party, write-in mark and votes are read.

The county's Election Summary Report, headed OFFICIAL RESULTS, linked as "Official Results Summary Report" from the clerk's results page (https://www.waynecountymi.gov/Government/Elected-Officials/Clerk/Elections/Election-Results-Candidates/2016-2020-Elections/2020/November-3-2020-General-Election-Results). One table a contest: the county's own figures by vote type. Its local contests are stored from it; its state contests are only compared with the Bureau's county file. Read with this site's PDF reader.
